character.randomization: The post-threshold sum is multiplied by a random integer 5..14. The highest result wins.

threshold.description: A random integer 1..3 is drawn. The religion's points from *cities alone* must meet or exceed the threshold for it to be eligible. The highest- scoring eligible religion wins. If none qualify, no religion is chosen.

whoRolls: Leader characters of human players never randomly choose a religion.

Other characters skip the roll if any other 'life event' happens that turn: giving birth (after Pregnant), gaining/losing a random adult trait, fathering a child, gaining/losing a random stat point, gaining a random archetype, or a random marriage proposal.
All other characters: 10% per-turn chance to attempt a religion choice.
Adults always attempt once that 10% hurdle is cleared. Characters aged ≤17 attempt with probability 1 / (1 + YluA), where YluA = years left until adulthood.
